text:
alex: FYI incoming from Acme - they want committed performance for their private pilot: p99 < 250ms and a signed onramp schedule. they want an answer by EOD.

maria: we can negotiate pilot vs GA expectations. need runtime + infra + sec signoff. Acme explicitly asked for HSM-backed keys and a private VPC.

devon: technical note: 250ms p99 for large-context chat is very aggressive with current batching and kv cache warmup. we can attempt burst prewarm + tighter batching window but will need dedicated nodes.

sasha: security: HSM procurement + attestation is ~3w. KMS-only with a signed risk acceptance could be approved faster. also need contract clause for key-handling.

elena: infra can stand up a reserved pool, but autoscale behavior and prewarm capacity must be spelled out. i'll estimate the monthly cost delta and post PR.

alex: can we draft minimal pilot commitment that we can actually deliver? must-have vs nice-to-have for the customer.

devon: must-have: dedicated pool in their region, KMS integration, canary with rollback. nice-to-have: HSM for pilot, strict 99.9% SLA before GA.

maria: propose we offer pilot SLA target p99 < 300ms, KMS for pilot, explicit HSM roadmap (commit to start HSM work during pilot, delivery N+4 weeks). we should make fallback behaviors explicit.

sasha: i'm ok with KMS pilot if Acme signs a limited risk waiver and we restrict sensitive dataset flows. i can fast-track the security checklist once contract excerpt is attached.

elena: action items: i'll open a capacity reservation PR with cost delta and reserved node counts. devon, confirm perf knobs needed (prewarm nodes, batch window, cache warmup) so i can size it.

devon: testing plan: run 2k synthetic conversations (avg 6k tokens) against staging quantized and unquantized models. baseline batching=auto small-window, prefix cache cold vs warm. expected staging p99 ~280-340ms; with KV warmup + burst nodes maybe ~250-270ms.

alex: include deployment/rollback triggers in the customer note. if pilot p99 > 350ms after mitigations, we route critical traffic back to hosted endpoints.

maria: i'll draft a customer-facing response today: pilot SLA p99 < 300ms, KMS-only encryption, HSM roadmap, rollback clauses, cost delta. also include acceptance criteria and measurement method (how we compute p99).

sasha: send the draft to security - need to confirm data retention and key handling sections. legal should expedite review.

elena: ops: we need a circuit-breaker runbook: thresholds, on-call pager, who approves scale, and automation knobs. ops-bot: please create incident/runbook template.

ops-bot: created runbook "acme-pilot-circuit-breaker" at https://redwood.internal/runbooks/acme-pilot-1840023456 (auto).

devon: one more technical ask: for GA-level SLA we'll want a quantized model variant and maybe a shortened context path for critical requests. add model-ops ticket for quantization experiments.

maria: added ticket to the initiative "acme-private-onramp" with owner and rough estimates.

elena: i'll link the capacity PR and cost estimates to that initiative board.

sasha: once contract excerpt is attached i can sign off on KMS pilot risk. HSM acceptance will require SOC attestation and a separate gating checklist.

alex: next steps recap: maria sends customer draft today; elena opens capacity PR; devon runs perf experiments and posts numbers; sasha prepares risk form; legal loops in for contract. reconvene async and do a short sync if we need to. :thumbsup:

maria: on it, i'll post the draft here and @alex for approval before sending.
